Date: 10/10/2026
Patient Name: Grace Ellis
DOB: 06/08/1975
MRN: MRN-13812

To: Cardiology Clinic Intake
From: Dr. George Chen, Maple Family Practice

Dear Colleague,

Reason for referral: Evaluation of exertional breathlessness that has gradually increased over the past three months.

Grace Ellis is a 51-year-old woman with hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and hypothyroidism. She reports gradually worsening breathlessness over the past three months when walking uphill or climbing one flight of stairs.

She denies breathlessness at rest, chest discomfort, fainting, or leg swelling. Please assess her exertional breathlessness and advise on further evaluation and management.

Thank you for seeing this patient.

Dr. George Chen
Maple Family Practice
